description: Land Acquisition - Andagala, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific lands for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land parcels, their locations, types (chena, paddy field, jungle, canal, etc.), claimants, and extents. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.
